topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: The news that my child has the same teacher I once had brings a heavy sigh. I can’t help but wander back to those days, the classroom echoes faint, the chalk dust still lingers in my mind. It’s a bridge between then and now, a connection I didn’t expect, and perhaps didn’t want. The world is smaller than it seems, or maybe it’s just this circle, this unbroken chain of years and desks and lessons learned. I hope the echoes from my past don’t overshadow the lessons my child needs to hear, clear and new, for their own path ahead.
